messages:
Maria H: @here Quick FYI — quiet window TOMORROW 02:00-03:00 UTC. Planning early drain @01:50. This impacts API, runtime, console, router. Runtime will flip kernel selection (KV-batching opt) at deploy. Need pin plan & rollback criteria. Who's on call?
Ajay R: I'm on runtime + router. Runtime image: runtime:v2.1.4-rc3 (sha:abc123). Router change is config-only (route weight adjust).
Sasha L: Console has a small activity-feed schema tweak that the clients must tolerate. I'll put it behind a feature flag. Recommend pin console -> api v2.1.4 for first 30m.
Ben P: Suggested rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m observation windows. Rollback if 5xx > 2% OR p50 latency increases > 50ms vs baseline.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Maria H: /deploy-wave 02:00 UTC — components: runtime, api, console, router. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
Maria H: Proposed pin set: api:v2.1.4, runtime:v2.1.4-rc3, console:v2.1.4-featureflag. Router: add fallback rule to router:v1.9 if error_rate>2% for 3m.
Ajay R: I'll add runtime health-check: /healthcheck runtime --path /live --expected 200. If failing >3 probes in 2m -> abort canary.
Sasha L: I'll add console feature flag disable_activity_schema_v2. Default ON during rollout; will flip OFF only after canary cleared.
Ben P: Release notes bullet: "kernel selection change — enables KV batching improvements; may increase memory per worker; rollback path available."
Maria H: Customer-facing blurb: "No API contract changes; console behavior behind feature flag. No expected user disruption."
Ajay R: Small snippet for deploy-bot usage: ```/deploy --component runtime --image ghcr.redwood/runtime:v2.1.4-rc3 --canary 5,25,100 --healthcheck /live --rollback-metric '5xx>2%'```
deploy-bot: Canary started 02:00: runtime @5% (sha:abc123). Observability: https://console.redwood/instrumentation/canary/3743216789
Ben P: Watching metrics. If I see an error spike I'll pull the pin and initiate router fallback.
Sasha L: I'm on standby to toggle feature flag and update release notes after canary passes 25%.
Maria H: Note to support — post a short blurb in #support 5m after 25% if things look green. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% at 02:05. No 5xx spike. p50 latency +20ms.
Ajay R: p50 looks fine, watching p95. I have runtime rollback image pinned: runtime:v2.1.3 (sha:def456) ready for immediate rollback.
Ben P: Locking rollback criteria: 5xx>2% OR p95 increase >150ms OR memory OOM >1 per host in 10m.
Maria H: Thanks all — I'll merge release notes and close the window at 03:10 to allow cooling. Will post final status in this thread. :white_check_mark:
